samples.topic: B.001 mission to tactical planning linkage
samples.ec_preview: Planning connects long-term strategy to operational budgets, responsibility assignments, and measurable targets.
Top-down budgeting can be efficient but may lack participation and detailed operational insight.
Participative budgeting improves information and commitment but can create budgetary slack if incentives are poorly designed.
A rolling budget continuously updates by adding a new period as the latest period ends.
Zero-based budgeting requires justification of activities and spending levels from the ground up.

methodological_notes.ls1: Domain-adaptive principle detection. For Sections B (Budgeting) and C (Performance Management), detects domain-specific concepts (flexible budget, standard cost, variance, balanced scorecard) rather than only ASC/GASB citations.
methodological_notes.ls2: Measures substantive distractor analysis: EW >80 chars, non-boilerplate, textually connected to choice. This captures the actual educational quality — Pack A's distractors are rich (300-400+ chars typical) but don't use 'misconception' keywords.
methodological_notes.ls3: Detects calculation-oriented items via formula language, math operators, financial terms, and step-by-step language.
methodological_notes.ls4: Checks for business terminology (company/management/controller/CFO/board/stakeholder/decision impact) in explanations.
methodological_notes.grade_formula: Weighted: EC depth(5) + distractor quality(5) + LS1(3) + LS2(3) + LS3(3) + LS4(2) + structural cleanliness(4) = max 25
